personality_one_liner: A high-contrast, strictly monochrome command center that treats educational administration with industrial precision and utility.

spacing.rule: Use rigid grids, exposed structure, and visible spacing. Elements should be tightly grouped with hard alignment. Empty space is intentional to create tension.

dont's: No blur or glassmorphism. This is a Brutalist app with hard, opaque surfaces.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Dashboard hub displaying the 7 utility modules and quick access to active classes.

states.loading: High-contrast skeleton blocks with mono-font 'LOADING...' labels.
states.error: Hard-bordered alert box with 'SYSTEM ERROR' and a stark retry button.

screens.layout: Vertical-first architecture. A top hero card for the primary module (Generator Modul Ajar) overlaid on a subtle grayscale photo. Below, a strict 2-column grid of hard-edged, borderStrong outlined cards for the remaining 6 modules. Use Space Grotesk for tool titles and Satoshi for short descriptions. No shadows, rely on 2pt borders.

screens.name: Module_Form
screens.purpose: Universal input form for generating Modul Ajar, Soal, Rubrik, Katrol Nilai, or KKTP mapping.

states.loading: Spinner replaced by a Brutalist progress bar or flashing text block.
states.empty: Clean form fields ready for input.
states.error: Input fields bordered in hard black with explicit error icons (crosses).

screens.layout: Single column layout. Labels above inputs in bold/mono caps. Inputs have hard 2pt borders. A sticky 'GENERATE' button at the bottom (brandPrimary) inside a KeyboardAvoidingView. Progressive disclosure: hide advanced settings behind a rigid, bordered accordion.

screens.name: Markdown_Viewer
screens.purpose: Renders AI-generated results (tables, lists, text) with a school letterhead (Kop Surat) and export options.

states.error: Failed to generate or format text.

screens.layout: Edge-to-edge scrolling view. Top section is the 'Kop Surat' template with a logo placeholder and centered serif/sans text. Below is the markdown content with JetBrains Mono used for tables and metrics. Hard 2pt divider lines between sections. A sticky bottom bar contains three stark buttons: Word, PDF, Excel.

screens.name: Attendance
screens.purpose: Field attendance tracker with health-safety status codes (H/S/I/A/K3).

states.empty: Illustration of a stopwatch with 'NO CLASS SELECTED'.

screens.layout: List-heavy view. Each row contains the student name and a segmented control (or set of rigid square toggles) for H, S, I, A, K3. The toggles use brandPrimary inversion for the selected state. A sticky summary bar at the bottom shows total counts and a 'SAVE' button.

screens.name: Profile_Archive
screens.purpose: Teacher profile, class/rombel management, and saved document repository.
screens.layout: Split layout: top section for teacher metadata and school info (hard-aligned left). Bottom section uses a tabbed view (Classes | Archives). Archives are listed as dense, data-rich rows with mono timestamps and download icons.

empty_state_stopwatch.alt: A close up of a stopwatch on a black background

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPLEMENTATION: Strictly adhere to the Brutalist Mobile personality. Zero border radius across all components (sm: 0, md: 0, lg: 0).

COLOR: The user explicitly requested a gray-black mix (abu-hitam). Stick entirely to the provided monochrome color tokens. Do not introduce ANY blues, indigos, or purples. Status colors (success, error) are also mapped to grayscale; rely on icons (checkmarks, crosses) to convey status to ensure accessibility.

TYPOGRAPHY: Use Space Grotesk for display/headers and Satoshi for body. IMPORTANT: Use a mono font like JetBrains Mono for all data tables, grading scaling output, and attendance codes to emphasize the industrial utility feel.
LAYOUT: Forms must use progressive disclosure (accordions) for advanced AI prompt settings to avoid overwhelming the user. Implement sticky CTA buttons at the bottom of forms and markdown viewers.

MARKDOWN: The markdown viewer must support robust table rendering (for grading and rubrics) with hard 2pt borders, aligning with the Brutalist theme. Include a 'Kop Surat' (school letterhead) template at the top.
ATTENDANCE: For the field attendance tracker, use dense list rows with a segmented control or 5 rigid square toggles for H, S, I, A, K3. Ensure touch targets are at least 44x44pt.
NAVIGATION: Use a bottom tab navigator for (1) Dashboard, (2) Active Class/Rombel, (3) Archive/Profile. The 7 modules should be pushed onto a Stack Navigator from the Dashboard.
